blocks.p: The moodles are the game's own small round marks for the state your character is in. ZNIX does not change them: it places them where you choose, and draws the note that explains one.
There are three places for them, set out in Table 32-1. To choose one on a controller, hold *View* for the ZeD wheel and choose *Moodles*.

table.label: Table 32-1
table.title: Where the moodles are shown
head: Choice
Where
rows: Down the right edge of the screen, where the game puts them.
Down the left edge of the screen (Figure 32-1).
In a row above the belt, in the middle of the screen. ZNIX draws this copy.

caption: Figure 32-1
The moodles on the left edge, with one balloon open.

marks.text: On the left edge, in the game's own column.

blocks.p: To learn what a moodle means, point at it. A balloon opens beside it, its tail on the moodle, with the name of the moodle and a line that says what it means. Figure 32-2 shows the row above the belt with the balloon for one moodle open, and the same moodles on the right edge of the screen.

caption: Figure 32-2
Above the belt, top, and on the right edge, bottom.

blocks.p: On the edges the moodles are the game's own; above the belt they are a copy drawn by ZNIX. The balloon is drawn by ZNIX in all three places.

marks.text: Point at a moodle and a balloon names it and says what it means.
Or in a row above the belt, in the middle of the screen. ZeD draws this copy.
Or on the right edge, the game's own place for it.

sticky.text: Put the moodles where you want them.
